description:
USB‑C rechargeable COB keychain work light is a mini LED torch built for real-life fixes—power cuts, roadside repairs, toolbox work, and finding keys in the dark. The wide COB flood beam lights up close areas better than a narrow torch, so you can see screws, wires, and small parts clearly. Switch between High, Low, and Strobe/SOS modes to match the moment: bright for repairs, low for battery-saving, and strobe for emergency signaling.

The magnetic base snaps onto metal surfaces for hands-free lighting, and the foldable stand lets you angle the beam exactly where you need it—under a hood, inside a cupboard, or on a workbench. With a built-in 500mAh battery and USB‑C charging, you can top it up from a phone charger or power bank and stop buying disposable batteries. Clip it to your keyring and you’ll always have a reliable light within reach.
